# awx_job_template_associate_instance_group (Resource)

Associates an AWX instance group with an AWX job template.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "awx_job_template_associate_instance_group" "ig" {
  instance_group_id = awx_instance_group.ig.id
  job_template_id   = awx_job_template.instance_group.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_group_id` (Number) Database ID of the instancegroup to assign.
- `job_template_id` (Number) Database ID for this JobTemplate.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# The import ID is <job_template_id>/<instance_group_id>
import {
  to = awx_job_template_associate_instance_group.example
  id = "1/2"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is <job_template_id>/<instance_group_id>
terraform import awx_job_template_associate_instance_group.example 1/2
```
